title: Repaint an avatar texture from a reference picture

comfyui.note: Uses only built-in ComfyUI nodes (plus the custom node listed, if any). Update ComfyUI if a node shows red.

models.name: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B (distilled)
models.licence: Apache-2.0 (the 4B only; FLUX.2 klein 9B is non-commercial)

models.name: Qwen3 4B text encoder (for Z-Image-Turbo and FLUX.2 klein 4B)

inputs.what: Your edit: say what to change
inputs.default: Repaint image 1 using the colours and materials of the character in image 2. Keep every shape, seam, island and line of image 1 exactly where it is. Flat even lighting, no shadows.

forWhat: Your model's texture sheet repainted in the colours and materials of a character picture. Every seam stays where it is.
output: A PNG the same size as your texture. Save it as a new file; keep the original.
vtp: Open your model in Blender (or the costume editor), swap the texture for the new PNG and check it from every side. For whole-model paint by camera views, VTube Pro's own painter (Create tab, "Paint with AI") does more.
ask: Set up the VTube Pro avatar texture repaint workflow in ComfyUI
steps: Load your texture sheet (the PNG from your model) in "Your texture".
Load a picture of the character in "Your reference".
Change the words if you like, then press Run.
tips: Faces stay hand-drawn: repaint clothes and hair, then fix the face by hand.
If a seam moved, lower "denoise" (small) or say "keep every line" (medium, large).
Run it when you are not live.
licenceSummary: Commercial use OK by default: Apache-2.0.
